segments.title: Pepito Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the official broadcast sign-on and countdown from the control room, claiming 800 speeches remain in him.

segments.title: DNC Day Two Coverage & Biden Speech Highlights
segments.notes: Case anchors live DNC coverage with Jeff Ripple reporting from the Chicago floor; Biden's emotional farewell speech and Hillary Clinton's address are replayed and dissected.

segments.title: Amongst the Web with Garf Gutter
segments.notes: Garf Gutter guest-hosts the viral video desk, rating viewer submissions including a bridge collapse, motorcycle breakdancing, English-learning diarrhea song, and a wholesome dust-mite philosophy clip.

segments.title: DNC Roll Call Live Reaction
segments.notes: Case, Chet, Rick, and Jeff watch the ceremonial state-by-state roll call, reacting to musical performances, celebrity delegates, and Minnesota's initial pass before Tim Walz's adopted son delivers an emotional endorsement.

segments.title: Seasonal Food Debate: Spring/Summer vs Fall/Winter
segments.notes: Munch argues for fall/winter citing Christmas, Halloween, and Thanksgiving; Crum champions spring/summer with sports cars and Easter America; debate devolves into blood sausage pacts and personal insults.

segments.title: DJ Newsic Gamescom Dick News & Sonic Rap
segments.notes: DJ Newsic covers video game sex-scene labor concerns, then debuts an explicit Sonic the Hedgehog rap before raiding Ricky Peacock.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored DNC coverage, hosted Amongst the Web handoff, moderated Munch & Crum debate, and endured new outro song.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered cold-open station sign-on and countdown from control room.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Reported live from DNC floor in Chicago, accidentally walked on stage twice, and claimed a dice-loss speech explanation.

characters.name: Rick
characters.notes: correspondent. Co-hosted DNC coverage, analyzed Biden speech applause breaks, and debated seasonal food preferences.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Walked through studio requesting a seven-minute check-in reminder for tattoo removal aftercare.

characters.name: Chet (Chet Manscape)
characters.notes: science correspondent. Joined DNC roll call coverage mid-stream, celebrated state announcements, and claimed Puerto Rico won the beauty pageant.

characters.name: Garf Gutter
characters.notes: guest host. Guest-hosted Amongst the Web, revealed birth name O'Shanisee, and shared construction-site pelvis-replacement lore.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argued fall/winter seasonal supremacy via Christmas/Halloween/Thanksgiving hierarchy and mocked Crum's blood sausage pact.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Defended spring/summer with sports cars and Easter America, invoked 2016 blood sausage pact, and touted crumb jet ascent.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Appeared during credits claiming responsibility for the extended credit roll and asking to attend Chicago DNC.

lore_notes.fact: Kendelle is undergoing tattoo removal on her back and needed help with aftercare application.
Garf Gutter's legal surname is O'Shanisee, not Gutter.
Garf Gutter claims to have slept on construction sites and had his pelvis replaced five or six times, not always by a doctor.
Peter Gibbon produced the extended credit sequence and expressed desire to attend the DNC in Chicago.
DJ Newsic performed an original Sonic the Hedgehog rap about sex in video games as the broadcast finale.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covered the second day of the Democratic National Convention with live floor reports from Jeff Ripple, highlights of Biden's farewell and Hillary Clinton's address, and a full ceremonial roll call reaction. Garf Gutter guest-hosted Amongst the Web with a slate of viewer videos, then Munch and Crum debated seasonal food supremacy before DJ Newsic closed with a Gamescom labor report and a graphic Sonic rap.
